style: Grimdark gothic sci-fi matte painting, wide cinematic establishing shot, colossal scale with tiny hooded robed figures for scale, sincere and monumental, layered atmospheric haze, volumetric light shafts, incense smoke, painterly concept art. Composition for a website header: the upper left third is calm dark vault or sky with little detail, the lower quarter is dark floor in deep shadow, the main structures stand in the middle distance. Original design. No text, no letters, no logos, no birds, no eagles, no wings, no emblem of a skull inside a cog, no floating skulls, no armoured space soldiers.

foundry-0.line: The Yard of the Kiln: an immense forge-cathedral nave, rows of towering arched kiln mouths each with one vertical slit of orange fire, iron buttresses, colossal statues of hooded machine-saints holding hammers between the arches, ranks of small robed acolytes at work, chains and ducts, warm amber haze.

foundry-1.line: The Rite of the Kiln: the forge-cathedral lit for liturgy, every kiln roaring, long tally marks in fives carved into the pillars, giant bronze censers swinging and pouring smoke, processions of hooded acolytes with candles, embers raining, banners of oxblood cloth.

foundry-2.line: The Undercroft beneath the Kiln: a vast ossuary undercroft, the walls built of countless bone skulls and rusted pipes descending into red darkness, robed figures wired into machines along the walls, steam and heat haze, red glow welling from grates.

foundry-3.line: The Closed Flue: a monolithic sealed flue rising into darkness with no opening, cracked walls glowing red hot, a storm of embers, hundreds of kneeling robed acolytes before a single blinding vertical slit of light in a giant arch, a colossal hooded statue looming above, overwhelming dread.

lattice-0.line: The Reading Room of the Loom: a vast gothic scriptorium nave of brass and verdigris looms, thousands of fine green glowing threads strung from floor to the ribbed vault, hooded scribes at lecterns, reading lamps, cool green dusk.

lattice-1.line: The Weaving: the great looms in motion, threads of green light woven into enormous hanging cloths covered in abstract glyphs, rows of robed weavers with mechanical arms, candle motes, ceremonial.

lattice-2.line: The Counting: endless hanging cloths of corrections and towering ledgers, threads cut and knotted, skull-lined niches between the looms, dim green light, robed counters bent over tallies, something hidden.

lattice-3.line: The Held Breath: every thread in the nave drawn taut to snapping, the weavers frozen kneeling, darkness closing in, a single green slit of light in the far wall, tense and silent.

crypt-0.line: The reading floor of the Vault: a deep candlelit archive cathedral, towering shelves of bound records and sealed reliquary drawers, brass catalogue rails, hooded archivists on ladders, warm candle pools, dust.

crypt-1.line: The lower stacks of the Vault: shelves rising out of sight, wax-sealed drawers with parchment strips, ossuary niches with skulls between the shelves, candles guttering, deeper shadows.

crypt-2.line: The sealed galleries of the Vault: long galleries behind iron grilles, chained record chests, walls of bone, dripping wax, a single row of candles leading into blackness, a robed keeper with a lantern.

crypt-3.line: The deepest Vault: a vast round chamber of sealed iron doors stacked to the ceiling, a colossal hooded statue with its hands over its mask, almost no light, one candle, dread.

warfront-0.line: The line at dawn: a fortified trench line of gothic bunkers and iron palisades across a grey wasteland, a cathedral-spired hive city on the horizon belching smog, cold blue haze, hooded sentries with lanterns, quiet before battle.

warfront-1.line: The line under artillery: smoke columns rising, distant flashes, searchlights sweeping a cold teal sky, ash falling like snow, banners of oxblood on poles, robed figures carrying censers along the trench.

warfront-2.line: The line burning: the spired city in flames on the horizon, colossal walking siege engines shaped like gothic cathedrals striding through smoke, fire along the trenches, orange fire against steel blue.

warfront-3.line: The line at the end: a black storm over a shattered trench line, lightning, the spired city a burning ruin, a colossal hooded statue toppled, everything lit by fire and lightning, apocalyptic.

siege-0.line: The Citadel wall in cold daylight: towering pale marble ramparts and gothic bastions, giant bronze statues of hooded robed guardians with halberds, long banners hanging still, pale overcast sky, solemn, high-key light palette.

siege-1.line: The Citadel mustering: pale marble ramparts lined with banners in wind, braziers lit, ranks of tiny robed defenders, thin smoke, pale grey sky, high-key light palette.

siege-2.line: The Citadel under siege: pale marble ramparts scarred and chipped, smoke across the bastions, a bronze guardian statue cracked, ash falling from a pale sky, still light-toned overall.

siege-3.line: The Citadel breached: a great breach in the pale marble ramparts, a bronze guardian statue fallen, fire and smoke against a white-grey sky, dust storm, still high-key and pale overall.

plain-0.line: Minimal calm landscape of soft grey fog over faint distant gothic spires, almost monochrome, very quiet, lots of empty space, high key.

nave-0.line: The Command Nave: a colossal gothic command chamber, rows of hooded machine-acolytes at lectern-consoles tending glowing green cables that all run up to one empty high throne-like dais of iron in the centre, pipe-organ exhaust stacks, hanging banners, skull niches, incense haze.
